title: Pagonia Land Paker Loca Info Report
description: JSON report emitted by `pagonia-paker loca info --json <path> <loca>`. Describes the decoded contents of a Pioneers of Pagonia compiled-localization blob (`<modulename>/localization/loca_<lang>.bin`): the flat, positionally ordered list of localized strings it carries, and any diagnostics from parsing. The format has no header or key table — strings are .NET 7-bit-length-prefixed UTF-8, read until end-of-stream — so the decode is best-effort.

Loca.description: Path to the loca_<lang>.bin file the report describes.

Success.description: True when the file parsed cleanly. On false, see Diagnostics for the parse error.

StringCount.description: Number of strings decoded from the blob.

Strings.description: The localized strings in on-disk order. The engine appears to resolve these by position from the GameDatabase side; no embedded keys are stored in the blob.
